AMD Ryzen 5 8400F Tray Processor

 Efficient 6-Core AM5 Processor for Modern Gaming PCs

 The AMD Ryzen 5 8400F Tray Processor is a smart and efficient choice for building a modern desktop PC focused on gaming, everyday performance, and smooth productivity. Designed as part of the AMD Ryzen 8000 Series, this processor delivers strong value for users who want an AM5-based system with DDR5 memory support and reliable multi-core performance. With 6 cores and 12 threads, the Ryzen 5 8400F is ideal for gamers, students, office users, content consumers, and PC builders who need a fast processor without paying for unnecessary extras.

 6 Cores and 12 Threads for Smooth Performance

 The Ryzen 5 8400F features 6 CPU cores and 12 processing threads, making it capable of handling gaming, browsing, multitasking, online work, streaming, and daily applications with confidence. The 12-thread design helps the processor manage multiple tasks at the same time, such as running a game while keeping Discord, browsers, launchers, and background apps open. This makes it a strong option for budget and mid-range gaming PCs where stable performance and efficiency are important.

 Up to 4.7GHz Boost Clock

 With a base clock of 4.2GHz and a maximum boost clock of up to 4.7GHz, the AMD Ryzen 5 8400F provides quick response times and strong single-core speed for modern software and games. Many popular games depend heavily on fast CPU performance, and the high boost frequency helps deliver smooth gameplay when paired with a capable graphics card. Whether the system is used for esports titles, open-world games, productivity software, or daily Windows tasks, this processor offers dependable speed for a wide range of users.

 Zen 4 Architecture with AM5 Platform Support

 Built on AMD Zen 4 architecture, the Ryzen 5 8400F offers modern performance and efficiency for desktop systems. It uses the AM5 socket, allowing compatibility with current AMD motherboards such as A620, B650, B650E, X670, X670E, B840, B850, X870, and X870E depending on BIOS support. The AM5 platform gives users access to newer technologies and a strong upgrade path, making this processor a practical starting point for a modern gaming or productivity PC.

 DDR5 Memory and PCIe 4.0 Support

 The Ryzen 5 8400F supports DDR5 memory, helping the system achieve faster memory bandwidth compared to older DDR4 platforms. It also supports PCIe 4.0, which is suitable for modern graphics cards and high-speed NVMe storage. This combination allows users to build a responsive PC with fast loading times, smooth system performance, and strong compatibility with today’s gaming hardware. For best results, the processor should be paired with a quality AM5 motherboard, DDR5 RAM, and a dedicated graphics card.

 Discrete Graphics Card Required

 The “F” model is designed for systems that use a separate graphics card. The AMD Ryzen 5 8400F does not include built-in graphics for display output, so a dedicated GPU is required to connect a monitor and use the system. This makes it especially suitable for gaming PCs, because most gaming builds already include a separate graphics card for better visual performance. When combined with the right GPU, the Ryzen 5 8400F can deliver a balanced and efficient gaming experience.

 Efficient 65W Power Design

 With a default TDP of 65W, the Ryzen 5 8400F is designed to deliver good performance while keeping power consumption under control. This efficient power profile helps reduce heat output, supports quieter cooling setups, and makes the processor easier to use in a wide range of PC cases. The processor also supports performance tuning features such as Precision Boost Overdrive, Curve Optimizer, AMD EXPO memory overclocking, and AMD Ryzen Master, giving advanced users more flexibility when optimizing their system.

 This is the Tray version of the AMD Ryzen 5 8400F, making it a practical option for custom PC builds and system assembly. Tr

 Powerful 12th Gen Performance for Gaming and Everyday Speed 

 The Intel Core i5-12400F Tray is an excellent choice for users who want strong desktop performance, smooth gaming, and fast day-to-day responsiveness without moving into a high-price CPU tier. This processor belongs to Intel’s 12th Gen Alder Lake family and features 6 cores and 12 threads, with a base clock of 2.5 GHz and boost speeds up to 4.4 GHz. It also includes 18MB of Intel Smart Cache and uses the LGA1700 socket, making it compatible with a wide range of modern Intel motherboards. Intel lists this model as a 65W processor base power chip, which helps it deliver a strong balance between performance and efficiency.

 Built for Dedicated Graphics Card Setups 

 One of the most important things to know about the i5-12400F is that it does not include integrated graphics. That is what the “F” in the model name means. This makes it ideal for systems that already use or will use a dedicated graphics card such as an RTX or Radeon GPU. For gaming PCs, this is often exactly what buyers want, because the processor focuses on strong CPU performance while the graphics card handles visual power. It is a practical and popular option for balanced gaming builds where value, stability, and real performance matter more than unnecessary extras.

 Excellent Choice for Gaming PCs 

 The Intel Core i5-12400F remains one of the smartest processors for mid-range gaming systems. Its 6 performance cores and 12 threads are more than enough for modern esports games, story-driven AAA titles, and multitasking during gameplay. It handles gaming, streaming apps in the background, browser tabs, Discord, and launchers smoothly in a properly balanced system. Because it offers strong single-core speed as well as enough threads for modern workloads, it gives a fast and responsive feel in real use. Whether the build is meant for 1080p competitive gaming or a strong all-around home PC, this processor fits the job very well.

 Modern Platform Support and Upgrade Flexibility 

 Another strong advantage of the i5-12400F is platform flexibility. Intel’s official specifications show support for both DDR4 and DDR5 memory, depending on the motherboard, as well as support for PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0. That means builders can choose a cost-effective DDR4 motherboard for better value or move to DDR5 for a newer platform path. This gives the processor more long-term usefulness than many older CPUs, especially for buyers who want to start with a balanced build now and upgrade parts later. It also supports up to 128GB of memory, which is more than enough for gaming, content work, office tasks, and heavy multitasking.

 Efficient, Cool, and Easy to Build Around 12400F 

 With a 65W processor base power and a mainstream performance design, the i5-12400F is also attractive for users who want good thermals and sensible power usage. It does not demand an extreme cooling setup or a very expensive motherboard to perform well. That makes it a clean fit for practical gaming PCs, office workstations, student systems, and mixed-use desktops. If the goal is to build a fast and reliable machine without overspending on power-hungry hardware, this CPU makes a lot of sense. It delivers the kind of performance most users actually feel every day: quick startup, fast app launches, smooth multitasking, and strong gaming results when paired with the right graphics card.

Intel’s ordering information identifies a dedicated tray variant for the Core i5-12400F, which is typically intended for system builders and custom PC assembly rather than standard boxed retail shelves. The combination of 6 Performance-cores for heavy foreground tasks and 4 Efficient-cores for background workloads helps the system stay responsive even when multiple applications are open. In real use, this means smoother gameplay, better multitasking, and faster overall behavior while gaming, streaming, browsing, or running communication apps at the same time. This flexibility is one reason the i5-13400F has remained such a strong option in custom PC markets.

Built for Fast Gaming and Modern Desktop Performance 

 The AMD Ryzen 5 7600 is a strong choice for users who want fast gaming performance, smooth everyday speed, and a modern platform that stays relevant for years. AMD lists this processor with 6 cores and 12 threads, a base clock of 3.8 GHz, boost speeds up to 5.1 GHz, 32 MB of L3 cache, and a 65W default TDP. That gives it an excellent balance between real performance, efficiency, and value for gaming PCs and all-around desktop builds.

 Excellent CPU for Gaming PCs 

 The Ryzen 5 7600 is especially attractive for gaming systems because it combines strong single-core speed with enough multi-threaded power for modern games and daily multitasking. In real use, that means smooth gameplay, fast system response, and a clean experience when running game launchers, browsers, Discord, and background apps at the same time. For users building a balanced gaming PC, this processor hits a very practical sweet spot without pushing the budget too far.

 Modern AM5 Platform with DDR5 and PCIe 5.0 

 One of the biggest advantages of the Ryzen 5 7600 is the platform behind it. AMD lists support for the AM5 socket, DDR5 memory, and PCIe 5.0, which gives builders access to a newer generation platform with better long-term upgrade flexibility. AMD also specifies support for up to 128 GB of memory and up to DDR5-5200 in supported configurations, making it a solid foundation for gaming, work, and future upgrades.

 Integrated Radeon Graphics for Basic Display Output 

 Unlike many “F” series Intel processors, the Ryzen 5 7600 includes AMD Radeon graphics. That means the processor can provide display output even without a dedicated graphics card, which is useful for testing, troubleshooting, or building a system before adding a stronger GPU later. For many users, that adds flexibility and convenience during building or maintenance.

 Unlocked for Overclocking and Memory Tuning 

 AMD lists the Ryzen 5 7600 as unlocked for overclocking and compatible with AMD EXPO memory overclocking technology. That makes it a good fit for enthusiasts who want extra tuning options, whether the goal is higher memory performance or squeezing more value from a gaming setup. Even without manual tuning, it already offers strong stock performance, but the option to push the platform further is there for users who want it.

 Efficient Performance with Included Cooling Support on Retail Specs 

 AMD’s support information lists the Wraith Stealth thermal solution for the Ryzen 5 7600 retail configuration, along with a maximum operating temperature of 95°C. In practice, that means the chip is designed to deliver strong mainstream performance without requiring an oversized cooling setup. For users building a clean and practical system, this helps keep the build efficient and easier to manage. For tray listings specifically, cooler inclusion depends on the seller, so that detail should always be confirmed at purchase time.

 A Smart Choice for Balanced Value 

 The AMD Ryzen 5 7600 is a smart processor for users who want current-generation desktop performance without overspending. With 6 cores, 12 threads, up to 5.1 GHz boost speed, AM5 support, DDR5 compatibility, PCIe 5.0 support, and built-in Radeon graphics, it fits very well in gaming PCs, home desktops, and productivity systems that need speed, flexibility, and strong value in one package.

AMD Ryzen 5 7600X3D Tray Desktop Processor

 Gaming-Focused Performance with AMD 3D V-Cache 

 The AMD Ryzen 5 7600X3D Tray is a high-performance gaming processor built for users who want strong frame rates, fast responsiveness, and the advantage of AMD 3D V-Cache on the AM5 platform. AMD lists this processor with 6 cores, 12 threads, and positions it as an enthusiast desktop CPU in the Ryzen 7000 Series. It is designed specifically for intense gaming workloads, making it a very strong option for performance-focused custom PC builds.

 Built for High-FPS Gaming Systems 

 What makes the Ryzen 5 7600X3D stand out is AMD 3D V-Cache technology, which is aimed directly at improving gaming performance. This makes the processor especially attractive for users building a gaming PC where low latency feel, smooth gameplay, and strong real-world FPS matter more than simply having more cores on paper. For balanced gaming builds, it gives a strong mix of speed, efficiency, and gaming value.

 Modern AM5 Platform with DDR5 and PCIe 5.0 Support 

 The Ryzen 5 7600X3D is built for the AM5 socket and supports modern platform technologies that make it a strong base for a current-generation gaming system. AMD’s specifications list support for AMD EXPO technology, integrated Radeon graphics, and platform features that fit the Ryzen 7000 ecosystem. That gives builders access to a newer platform with better upgrade potential and modern compatibility for future-ready systems.

 Integrated Radeon Graphics for Basic Display and Testing 

 Unlike processors that need a graphics card just to output a display, the Ryzen 5 7600X3D includes AMD Radeon graphics. AMD lists 2 graphics cores with a 2200 MHz graphics frequency, which is useful for testing, troubleshooting, BIOS setup, or temporary use before installing a dedicated GPU. That adds flexibility during building and maintenance.

 Tray Version for Custom PC Builders 

 This version is the Tray model. AMD’s support page lists a dedicated tray product ID for the Ryzen 5 7600X3D: 100-000001721 . That means this is the OEM-style version intended for custom builders and system integrators rather than standard boxed retail packaging. In practice, tray CPUs are usually sold without retail box accessories, so cooler and seller warranty details should always be confirmed before purchase. AMD also separates tray/OEM processors from boxed processor warranty handling.

 A Strong Choice for Premium Gaming Builds 

 The AMD Ryzen 5 7600X3D Tray is an excellent choice for users who want a gaming-focused AM5 processor with 6 cores, 12 threads, integrated graphics for flexibility, and AMD 3D V-Cache for stronger gaming results. It is especially suitable for custom gaming PCs where performance, platform longevity, and real gaming advantage matter most.

Whether you are gaming, streaming, editing videos, working with large files, browsing with many tabs open, or running professional software, this processor provides smooth and stable performance. The 16-thread design helps improve productivity in applications that benefit from multi-core processing, while the fast Zen 5 cores keep the system feeling quick and responsive during daily use.

 Up to 5.5GHz Boost Clock for Fast Gaming Performance

 With a base clock of 3.8GHz and a maximum boost clock of up to 5.5GHz, the AMD Ryzen 7 9700X is built to deliver strong performance in modern games and demanding applications. The high boost frequency helps improve frame rates, reduce delays, and provide a smoother experience in competitive and high-refresh-rate gaming. When paired with a powerful graphics card, this processor can handle modern gaming titles at high settings while maintaining excellent system responsiveness.

The AM5 platform is ideal for new gaming builds and professional systems that need strong upgrade potential.

 Efficient 65W Power Design

 One of the key advantages of the Ryzen 7 9700X is its efficient 65W default TDP. This allows the processor to deliver strong performance while producing less heat compared to many higher-power desktop CPUs. Lower power consumption can help create a quieter and more efficient system, especially when combined with a quality aftermarket cooler. This makes the Ryzen 7 9700X a great choice for users who want high performance without unnecessary heat or excessive power usage.

 Tray Version for Custom PC Builds

 This is the Tray version of the AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, which is commonly used for custom PC builds, professional assembly, and system integration. Tray processors usually come without retail packaging and without a bundled stock cooler, making them ideal for users who already plan to use an aftermarket air cooler or liquid cooling solution. This version is perfect for gaming PC builders who want clean installation, reliable performance, and flexibility when choosing their cooling system.

 The AMD Ryzen 7 7700X Box is a powerful desktop processor for users who want strong gaming performance, fast response in daily use, and a modern platform with long upgrade life. AMD lists this processor with 8 cores, 16 threads, a base clock of 4.5 GHz, and max boost up to 5.4 GHz . It is designed for the AM5 socket and belongs to the Ryzen 7000 Series built around the Zen 4 generation.

 Excellent Choice for Gaming PCs 

 AMD presents the Ryzen 7 7700X as a gaming-focused desktop processor, and its specs make that clear. With 8 cores and 16 processing threads , it is well suited for modern AAA gaming, competitive titles, streaming apps in the background, and heavy multitasking at the same time. Its high boost clock helps deliver the fast, responsive feel users want in premium gaming builds.

 Modern AM5 Platform with DDR5 and PCIe 5.0 Support 

 One of the biggest strengths of the Ryzen 7 7700X is the platform behind it. AMD’s Ryzen 7000 desktop platform supports DDR5 memory, PCIe 5.0, and AMD EXPO memory overclocking , which makes this CPU a strong base for a modern build with good future upgrade flexibility. That is a big advantage for users building a serious gaming PC today and wanting a platform that stays useful later.

 Unlocked Performance for Enthusiast Builds 

 The Ryzen 7 7700X is also positioned as an unlocked desktop processor , which makes it attractive for users who want extra tuning headroom and enthusiast-level control over their system. In practice, that means it fits very well in premium custom PCs where performance matters, whether the use is gaming, content work, or a mix of both.

 Box Version for Retail Sale

Store listings for the boxed product identify it as “BOX” , and AMD’s retail presentation also shows the standard Ryzen 7 retail packaging. Another important detail: multiple sources indicate cooler not included , so the buyer should use a compatible AM5 cooler.

 Strong Option for Premium Builds 

 The AMD Ryzen 7 7700X Box is a very solid choice for users who want a powerful 8-core / 16-thread gaming and productivity CPU with up to 5.4 GHz boost , modern AM5 support, and access to the Ryzen 7000 ecosystem. whiteangel-1ktguua.description:
The Intel® Core™ i7-14700KF is one of Intel’s most advanced desktop CPUs, crafted for performance enthusiasts who need raw speed, multitasking power, and precise control. Built on the Raptor Lake Refresh architecture , this 14th Generation processor pushes desktop computing to a new level — blending cutting-edge hybrid technology with massive processing capability.

 🚀 Extreme Hybrid Architecture for Ultimate Speed 

 At its core, the i7-14700KF uses Intel’s powerful hybrid design that combines 8 Performance-cores (P-cores) and 12 Efficient-cores (E-cores) for a total of 20 cores and 28 threads . The Performance-cores deliver incredible single-threaded speed for gaming and demanding workloads, while the Efficient-cores handle background tasks and parallel operations with exceptional energy efficiency.

 With boost frequencies reaching up to 5.6 GHz , the i7-14700KF ensures instant responsiveness, faster load times, and smoother multitasking — whether you’re gaming, editing, streaming, or running professional applications.

 🎮 Designed for Elite Gaming 

 The i7-14700KF is a powerhouse for gaming enthusiasts. With its 20 core hybrid design and high turbo clocks, it delivers exceptional frame rates and low latency across all modern AAA titles. It ensures superior performance in competitive gaming, VR experiences, and high-refresh-rate monitors. Combined with a powerful discrete GPU, it eliminates bottlenecks, providing smooth and consistent gameplay.

 Since this is a KF variant , it does not include integrated graphics , making it perfect for systems that rely entirely on a dedicated GPU for rendering. This configuration allows the CPU to focus all its energy on raw processing performance.

 🧩 Unlocked for Overclocking Freedom 

 As an unlocked processor , the i7-14700KF gives you full control to customize your system’s performance. Using a compatible motherboard (Z690, Z790, or later), enthusiasts can tweak multipliers, voltages, and frequencies to achieve optimal performance. When paired with high-quality cooling, such as liquid cooling or advanced air solutions, the i7-14700KF can maintain incredible stability even when pushed beyond its rated specifications.

 Intel’s performance-tuning technologies — like Intel® Extreme Tuning Utility (XTU) and Thermal Velocity Boost — make it easier to unlock extra speed safely and efficiently.

 💼 Built for Creators and Professionals 

 Beyond gaming, the i7-14700KF is a true workhorse for creators and professionals. Its 20 cores and 28 threads make it a perfect fit for demanding workloads such as video editing, 3D rendering, AI computation, photo editing, and software development . Applications like Adobe Premiere Pro, Blender, and DaVinci Resolve benefit greatly from the processor’s high multi-core performance, while its superior single-core speed ensures quick rendering previews and faster export times.

 Thanks to Intel’s Thread Director technology , tasks are automatically distributed between P-cores and E-cores for maximum efficiency. This smart scheduling guarantees consistent responsiveness even under heavy multitasking conditions.

 ⚙️ Next-Generation Platform Support 

 The Intel® Core™ i7-14700KF supports both DDR5 and DDR4 memory, giving you flexibility to choose between cutting-edge performance or cost-effective configurations.

 
• 
 DDR5 support up to 5600 MT/s for next-generation speed.

• 
 DDR4 support up to 3200 MT/s for broad compatibility.

 
 Additionally, the processor offers PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 compatibility, enabling ultra-fast data transfer for the latest GPUs and NVMe SSDs. This ensures your system remains future-ready for years to come.

 🔥 Thermal Performance and Cooling Requirements 

 With a base power (TDP) of 125 W and a maximum turbo power of around 253 W, the i7-14700KF requires robust cooling to perform at its best. A premium air cooler or AIO liquid cooler is highly recommended, especially for overclocking enthusiasts.

The Intel® Core™ i7-14700F is a high-performance desktop processor built for gamers, creators, and professionals who demand power, efficiency, and reliability. Part of Intel’s 14th Generation Raptor Lake Refresh lineup, this processor brings together a hybrid architecture, high core count, and cutting-edge platform support to handle even the most demanding tasks with ease.

 🚀 Next-Level Hybrid Architecture 

 The i7-14700F is engineered with Intel’s advanced Performance Hybrid Architecture , which combines 8 Performance-cores (P-cores) and 12 Efficient-cores (E-cores) — for a total of 20 cores and 28 threads . The P-cores handle heavy, single-threaded workloads such as gaming and design software, while the E-cores focus on background processes and multitasking. This intelligent balance allows the processor to maintain smooth responsiveness even when running multiple demanding applications simultaneously.

 With turbo speeds reaching up to 5.4 GHz , this processor delivers blazing-fast responsiveness, minimal lag, and superior real-world performance across a wide range of workloads.

 🎮 Built for Serious Gaming 

 Gamers will appreciate the i7-14700F’s powerful architecture that ensures excellent frame rates, low latency, and smooth performance even in the most demanding AAA titles. The combination of high clock speeds and a large 33 MB cache provides instant access to game data, reducing stuttering and loading times.

 Since this is an “F” variant , it does not include integrated graphics , which makes it ideal for users who plan to use a dedicated GPU . This configuration allows all available power and thermal resources to be focused on CPU performance, delivering pure, efficient processing for gaming and content creation.

 🧩 Optimized for Multitasking and Creativity 

 Beyond gaming, the i7-14700F excels at professional and creative workloads. Whether you’re editing videos, rendering 3D scenes, streaming, programming, or compiling large projects, this CPU offers the performance you need. The 20 cores and 28 threads make it possible to run multiple intensive applications simultaneously without slowdowns. Software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Blender, and AutoCAD benefit greatly from the high multi-core throughput and fast clock speeds.

 Intel’s Thread Director technology works seamlessly with Windows to assign tasks intelligently to the right cores, ensuring maximum efficiency and performance at all times.

 ⚙️ Platform and Compatibility 

 The Intel Core i7-14700F is built for the LGA1700 socket , ensuring compatibility with Intel 600-series and 700-series motherboards (such as Z690, Z790, B660, and B760). It supports both DDR5 and DDR4 memory, giving you the freedom to choose between cutting-edge performance or cost-effective configurations.

 
• 
 DDR5 support: Up to 5600 MT/s or higher (depending on motherboard)

• 
 DDR4 support: Up to 3200 MT/s

 
 In addition, the i7-14700F supports PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 , delivering the bandwidth needed for next-generation graphics cards, SSDs, and high-speed peripherals. This future-proof platform ensures your system is ready for the latest technologies.

 🔥 Thermal Design and Cooling 

 With a base power (TDP) of approximately 65 W and a maximum turbo power that can reach around 219–250 W under load, the i7-14700F requires efficient cooling to maintain peak performance. A high-quality air cooler or AIO liquid cooler is recommended, especially for users running demanding workloads or extended gaming sessions.

 Proper thermal management not only sustains high turbo frequencies but also prolongs the processor’s lifespan and system stability.

whiteangel-1djmiy1.description:
AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D Desktop Processor – 16 Cores, 32 Threads, Up to 5.7GHz, AM5

 The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a flagship desktop processor built for users who want elite gaming performance and serious creation power in one CPU. With 16 cores, 32 threads, advanced Zen 5 architecture, and 2nd Gen AMD 3D V-Cache technology, this processor is made for high-end gaming PCs, streaming setups, rendering workstations, and premium multitasking builds.

 Flagship Performance for Gaming and Productivity

 The Ryzen 9 9950X3D delivers a strong balance between extreme gaming speed and heavy multi-core performance. It features a base clock of 4.3GHz and boost speeds up to 5.7GHz, allowing it to handle modern AAA games, demanding creative applications, and intensive background tasks with ease. It is an ideal choice for enthusiasts who want one processor that performs at the highest level in both work and play.

 Advanced 3D V-Cache Technology

 One of the biggest advantages of the Ryzen 9 9950X3D is AMD’s 3D V-Cache technology, which gives the processor a major advantage in gaming workloads that benefit from large cache capacity. This helps reduce latency, improve frame consistency, and deliver smoother overall gaming performance in a wide range of titles.

 Massive Cache Capacity

 This processor includes 1280KB of L1 cache, 16MB of L2 cache, and a huge 128MB of L3 cache. That large cache layout helps keep frequently used data close to the CPU, improving responsiveness and boosting performance in both games and productivity workloads.

 Built on the Modern AM5 Platform

 The Ryzen 9 9950X3D uses the AM5 socket, giving users access to AMD’s latest desktop platform with modern connectivity and long-term upgrade potential. It supports PCIe 5.0 for next-generation graphics cards and ultra-fast SSDs, making it a strong foundation for a premium modern desktop build.

 Wide Chipset Compatibility

 This processor is compatible with a wide range of AMD chipsets including A620, B650, B650E, X670, X670E, B840, B850, X870, and X870E, depending on motherboard BIOS support. This gives builders flexibility when choosing between value-focused boards and high-end enthusiast motherboards.

 DDR5 Memory Support

 The Ryzen 9 9950X3D supports DDR5 memory and dual-channel architecture, helping unlock high-speed memory performance for gaming, creation, and advanced multitasking. It also supports AMD EXPO technology for easier memory tuning on compatible kits and motherboards.

 Made for Enthusiast PC Builds

 This CPU is designed for users who expect more from their desktop. Whether you are building a high-refresh-rate gaming PC, a workstation for video editing and 3D rendering, or a premium setup for streaming and multitasking, the Ryzen 9 9950X3D offers the power needed for demanding real-world use.

 Unlocked for Tuning

 The processor is unlocked, giving enthusiasts access to advanced tuning features such as Precision Boost Overdrive, Curve Optimizer, and Ryzen Master support. This allows users to fine-tune performance, thermals, and power behavior to match their cooling setup and performance goals.

 Integrated Radeon Graphics

 The Ryzen 9 9950X3D also includes integrated Radeon graphics, which can be useful for troubleshooting, display output, BIOS setup, and temporary use before installing a dedicated graphics card. While most buyers will pair this processor with a high-end GPU, integrated graphics still add flexibility and convenience during setup or maintenance.

 Cooling and Power Requirements

 This is a high-performance processor with a default TDP of 170W, so strong cooling is important for best results. AMD does not include a cooler in the box, and a high-quality liquid cooler is recommended to maintain optimal temperatures and sustained performance under heavy gaming or creator workloads.

AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D AM5 CPU Processor (Tray)
 The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is AMD's ultimate flagship processor — a 16-core, 32-thread AM5 powerhouse combining Zen 5 architecture with AMD's revolutionary 3D V-Cache technology. With boost clocks up to 5.7 GHz and a massive stacked cache, the 9950X3D delivers unmatched performance in gaming, content creation, simulation, and AI workloads.
 Note: This is a Tray (OEM) version — the processor comes without retail packaging or a bundled cooler. A high-performance aftermarket CPU cooler is required.
 Key Specifications
 
• 
 Cores / Threads — 16 Cores / 32 Threads

• 
 Base Clock — 4.0 GHz

• 
 Boost Clock — Up to 5.7 GHz

• 
 Architecture — Zen 5 with 3D V-Cache

• 
 Socket — AM5 (LGA1718)

• 
 TDP — 170W

• 
 Cache — 144MB Total Cache (16MB L2 + 128MB L3 with 3D V-Cache)

• 
 Memory Support — DDR5 up to 5600MHz

• 
 PCIe Version — PCIe 5.0

 The Pinnacle of CPU Performance
 Imagine rendering complex 3D scenes while streaming, or dominating the most CPU-intensive games at maximum framerates — the Ryzen 9 9950X3D makes it effortless. The combination of Zen 5's exceptional IPC, 16 high-performance cores, and 128MB of stacked 3D V-Cache creates a processor that excels in every scenario. This is the CPU for professionals, enthusiasts, and gamers who accept nothing but the best.
 Compatibility
 
• Socket: AM5 (LGA1718)

• Compatible with AMD 600-series motherboards (B650, X670, X670E) — BIOS update may be required

• Requires DDR5 memory

• No integrated graphics — discrete GPU required

• High-performance aftermarket cooling strongly recommended due to 170W TDP

 In the Box
 • 1x AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D Processor (Tray, no retail box or cooler)
